finding: Public sources provide term sheets and taxonomy, but no verified free bulk dataset of settled Phoenix outcomes was found.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR Rule 424(b)(2) pricing supplements
sources.use: Primary source for US note terms and legal risk disclosures.
limitations: A prospectus is an offered product, not a realized outcome.
Coverage and issuer scope must be measured.

sources.name: Borsa Italiana listed certificate term sheets
sources.use: European structured-product terms and payoff examples.
limitations: PDF extraction and legal-document versioning are required.
Term sheet may be incomplete relative to the base prospectus.

sources.name: Morgan Stanley Europe final terms
sources.use: Additional issuer-format examples for Phoenix/autocall final terms.
limitations: Must be downloaded and parsed with document hashes.

sources.name: EUSIPA Product Map
sources.use: Product taxonomy and normalized payoff classification.
limitations: Taxonomy only; not a row-level instrument or outcome dataset.

sources.name: SRP Structured Products database
sources.use: Potential large-scale normalized product reference and API.
limitations: Paid access and licensing must be confirmed.
Do not assume API access or outcome coverage.

sources.name: Exchange Data International / SQX reference data
sources.use: Potential machine-readable SEC-derived terms and payoff fields.
limitations: Paid access and redistribution rights must be confirmed.
Reference data is not automatically settled-outcome data.

sources.name: VegaInstitute Autocallable Notes Pricing
sources.use: Engine regression tests, surrogate-pricer benchmarks and sensitivity tests.
limitations: Not market evidence and cannot close OOS or production gates.

sources.name: Academic structured-product studies
sources.use: Methodology and evidence about large historical structured-product samples.
limitations: Underlying datasets are not necessarily downloadable.
Use as methodology/reference until access and licensing are verified.

recommended_order: Extract and hash SEC/Borsa/Morgan Stanley public term sheets.
Map every extracted product to EUSIPA taxonomy.
Use synthetic Hugging Face data only for engine tests and sensitivity.
Request commercial demos/licensing only if free sources cannot provide coverage.
Join term sheets to authorized market paths and realized outcomes before OOS.
